summaryZh: Chalasani 实验室研究神经系统如何整合环境信号以驱动行为，采用秀丽隐杆线虫与小鼠模型。团队发展声遗传学以非侵入方式控制哺乳动物回路，并结合纳米尺度膜形变生物物理建模与系统神经科学。
researchQuestions: 神经系统如何整合环境信号以驱动行为？

evidence.quote: We explore how the nervous system integrates environmental signals to drive behavior using C. elegans and M. musculus . As pioneers in Sonogenetics, we are expanding our toolkit, from early work in worms to the optimization of human channels like hsTRPA1, for precise, non-invasive control of mammalian circuits. By pairing biophysical modeling of nanoscale membrane deflections with systems neuroscience, we aim to uncover universal principles of brain function
